title: Compiled Machine Initial Configuration
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, $l_0$ an initial program state, $D$ a decider machine, $q_0$ an assignment of initial decider states, and $x$ an input word. The compiled nondeterministic machine's initial configuration on $x$ is the configuration formed by adjoining blank auxiliary tapes to the initial arithmetic configuration at $l_0$, with every register equal to zero and the output empty.
hypotheses_covered: $q_0$ assigns an initial state to each decider
